A mysterious radio signal is driving the people of Suspiria insane. At least, that is what the reports say. Lia can't say she cares, but work is work.

[From [url=https://taumilicorice.itch.io/carmin-am]itch.io[/url]]

一道神秘的无线电信号正令苏斯皮里亚城的居民陷入疯狂——至少报告上是这么写的。莉娅谈不上有多关心这件事，但工作终归是工作。
